queens.name: Queens
queens.rules: Place one queen in each row, each column and each colored region. Two queens can never touch, not even diagonally.
queens.howTo: Tap a cell to place a queen, tap it twice for a cross. Drag your finger to cross out several cells.

today.title: Daily puzzle
today.updateAvailable: A Griday update may be available: install it to keep playing the same grids as everyone else.

unlimited.title: Unlimited mode
unlimited.empty: Pick a size and a difficulty, then start a new grid.

game.resetConfirm: Clear the whole grid and reset the timer?

single.region: The highlighted region has only one possible cell left: its queen must go there.
single.row: Row {{row}} has only one possible cell left: its queen must go there.
single.column: Column {{col}} has only one possible cell left: its queen must go there.

region-line.row: All possible cells of the highlighted region are in row {{row}}. That row’s queen will therefore be in the region, so the other cells of row {{row}} are ruled out.
region-line.column: All possible cells of the highlighted region are in column {{col}}. That column’s queen will therefore be in the region, so the other cells of column {{col}} are ruled out.

line-region.row: All possible cells of row {{row}} are in the same region. That region’s queen will therefore be in row {{row}}, so its other cells are ruled out.
line-region.column: All possible cells of column {{col}} are in the same region. That region’s queen will therefore be in column {{col}}, so its other cells are ruled out.

queens.attack: A queen on the marked cell would remove every possible cell of {{unit}}, which would then have no queen: this cell is ruled out.

locked.regions-rows: These {{count}} regions only have possible cells in rows {{lines}}. Those rows are reserved for them, so their other cells are ruled out.
locked.regions-columns: These {{count}} regions only have possible cells in columns {{lines}}. Those columns are reserved for them, so their other cells are ruled out.
locked.rows-regions: Rows {{lines}} only have possible cells in {{count}} regions. Those regions’ queens are therefore in these rows, so their other cells are ruled out.
locked.columns-regions: Columns {{lines}} only have possible cells in {{count}} regions. Those regions’ queens are therefore in these columns, so their other cells are ruled out.
locked.rows-columns: Rows {{lines}} only have possible cells in columns {{targets}}. Those columns are reserved for them, so their other cells are ruled out.
locked.columns-rows: Columns {{lines}} only have possible cells in rows {{targets}}. Those rows are reserved for them, so their other cells are ruled out.

queens.contradiction: Suppose there is a queen on the marked cell: following the simple deductions, {{unit}} would have no possible cell left. That is impossible, so this cell is ruled out.
queens.reveal: No simple deduction here: here is one queen of the solution.
queens.mistake_one: One cell is wrong: it is shown in red. Fix it before going on.
queens.mistake_other: {{count}} cells are wrong: they are shown in red. Fix them before going on.

dynamicColor.title: Dynamic colors
dynamicColor.description: Use the colors of your wallpaper

autoCross.title: Automatic crosses
autoCross.description: Cross out the cells ruled out by each queen

patterns.title: Region patterns
patterns.description: Add a texture to each region to tell them apart (colour blindness)

errors.generation: The grid could not be prepared. Please try again.
errors.engineCheck: This device computes grids differently: your daily puzzle might not match other players’.
